meta.title: Ariadne Architecture Evolution · Local to Unified Markdown

views.label: Start · Local Job Radar
views.note: The project began as a local Job Radar: SQLite stored jobs while the UI handled search, status, and human review.

views.label: Accuracy · Local Analysis
views.note: Accurate PDFs, screenshots, and résumés required open-source comparisons and tests across OCR, order, structure, and review.

views.label: Structure Is Not Understanding
views.note: Local structure was not useful understanding, so model semantics were added; Candidate and Job stay separate, with Human Save.

views.label: Simplify the Complex System
views.note: The boundaries were correct, but the system became heavy; repeated representations and calls were merged without removing safeguards.

views.label: Current · Rebuild Local Storage
views.note: The old store still had competing truths and migration problems, so one Markdown body now projects both cards and scoped AI context.

components.label: ① Job Radar
components.sublabel: local SQLite jobs / search and status

cards.title: Why Complexity Was Added First
items: Accuracy required open-source comparisons, benchmarks, and A/B tests across OCR, order, and structure
Models add meaning; Proposal and Human Save keep inference from silently becoming fact

cards.title: Why the System Was Simplified
items: Figure 1 spread correct boundaries across storage, Runtime, services, and proposals
Local archives originals; one discussion uses complete in-budget evidence, while only large sets are chunked

cards.title: Why Storage Was Rebuilt Again
items: IndexedDB and derived structures created competing truths and exposed historical hash differences
One Markdown body now projects cards and scoped AI; the old store is backup-only
